newsitem.title: UK: Greece buys 940,000 tonnes gas oil in tender - trade. [Corrected 17:58 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Greece buys 940,000 tonnes gas oil in tender - trade. [Corrected 17:58 gmt]

text.p: (Corrects size of purchase from 720,000 in headline and text)
Greece's state-run Public Petroleum Corp (PPC) has bought about 940,000 tonnes of heating oil in its tender for delivery from October to March, traders said on Friday.

The tender for 0.2 percent sulphur gas oil was awarded to Glencore with 450,000 tonnes (corrects from 200,000-250,000) at cif high +25 cents; Neoinvest with 200,000-250,000 tonnes at cif high +71 cents (corrects from +35 cents); Statoil with 180,000 tonnes at cif high +70 cents (corrects from 75 cents); and Transax with 90,000 tonnes at cif high +40 cents (corrects from +50 cents), they said.
Traders said the actual volume of imports would depend on the severity of the winter and may not reach 940,000 tonnes.
"The volume is something of a moveable feast," said one award winner.
